newsitem.title: USA: Xechem sees filing for paclitaxel sale.
newsitem.headline: Xechem sees filing for paclitaxel sale.

text.p: Xechem International Inc said Tuesday it expects to file an abbreviated new drug application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration late this year or early next year for the domestic sale of paclitaxel, used to fight ovarian cancer.
Bristol-Myers Squibb Co holds exclusive rights to sell paclitaxel, a right that lapses in December, 1997, Xechem said. Bristol-Myers markets the drug under the name Taxol.
Xechem, a bio-pharmaceutical company, said it anticipates filing the application in late 1997 or early 1998. It said it also expects to file applications in select European markets.
